item.title: University of Arkansas for Medical Sciences gets $40 million in congressional appropriations for program support
item.description: The University of Arkansas for Medical Sciences will receive $40 million in congressional appropriations to fund programs targeting infant and maternal mortality, as well as other initiatives to improve health and wellness.

item.title: Police issue safety warning after robbery reported at University of Arkansas
item.description: The University of Arkansas Police Department (UAPD) is investigating a robbery reported Monday at around 2 p.m. near the Bell Engineering Center and Science-Engineering Hall.

item.title: Foster a pet for Valentine's Eve with Best Friends Society
item.description: Best Friends Animal Society host 2nd annual sleepover event on Valentine's Day Eve.

item.title: WEATHER BLOG: Fayetteville sees Record High, Rain Ahead
item.description: NORTHWEST ARKANSAS/RIVER VALLEY, Ark. (KNWA/KFTA) — Fayetteville set a new record high for February 9th, but Tuesday will shake the pattern up with a cold front that'll drop temperatures slightly and return some rain to Northwest Arkansas.

item.title: Co-founder of Arkansas whites-only group sued over Ecuador land deal
item.description: Peter Csere, a co-founder of the controversial whites-only Arkansas community Return to the Land (RTTL), is facing a lawsuit filed by a Sharp County man who alleges Csere failed to convey legal title after collecting thousands of dollars in connection with a property transaction in Ecuador.

item.title: Steve Womack votes for housing affordability bill
item.description: Steve Womack votes for housing for the 21st Century Act to expand affordability and availability of homes.
